selection: Ten liquid commodity benchmarks with numeric covariates and event summaries; selected before inspecting their predictive results, not a verified ranking of dataset abundance
models: Existing frozen B1, M and Sdir definitions; Cavg=0.5*M+0.5*Sdir; train each commodity separately
dictionary: Existing eight macro topics transferred unchanged; commodity-specific extraction accuracy unmeasured
primary: Cavg MAE versus B1; also compare M, Sdir and zero change
uncertainty: 5000 moving-block bootstrap replicates length3, descriptive 95% intervals; no multiple-testing correction; no validity probability
gates: >=5% overall improvement, positive descriptive interval lower bound, improvement in both 2024 and 2025 are screening only; provenance and independent prospective validation still required
